audit.why: Early leans Zed (energy poke before Viktor's kit exists), mid is a skill lane, level 6 is Zed's kill window, two-plus items Viktor — TRICKY 7/10 fits 53.15% WR.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart layers disagreed on where Zed's spike sits: full has Level 6 = Zed / First item = Skill, while content and the packet had them swapped — yet every piece of prose (spikes[1], whys[5], late) says 6 is his decisive R window and first item flips the lane back.
audit.why: Zed's R is his kill spike; all prose supports the full layer's placement.
audit.corrected: Content win[4] moved to Zed and win[5] to Skill with whys rewritten, aligning both layers with the prose.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Death Ray (W)' in content mid (real: Hextech Ray, E slot — packet flagged it); Gravity Field labelled (E) in spikes[0] and wants.you[0] (it is W); cooldowns field had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pastes; the untargetable-R interaction from missingInteractions was absent.
audit.why: Kit is the slot/name authority; Zed R makes him untargetable during the dash (kit flag plus description).
audit.corrected: Names and slots fixed; cooldowns now carries R 120/110/100s, Living Shadow 20s and the untargetable warning; bleed bullets rewritten.

audit.why: Living Shadow 20s rank 1 is the trade window; Death Mark 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d carried MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE findings.
audit.why: matchup-lint.js flagged these classes; QA pass owns them.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to enemy gender; duplicated dos/donts rephrased; kit cooldown digits added (Malzahar R 140s, Viktor W 17s, Neeko E 12s); Mimic magnitude claim replaced with its mechanic.

edits.before: Q-shield trades on his last-hits — the empowered auto walk-away is sneakily one of the better level-1 trades mid.
edits.after: His double-Q and return-shadow poke beat your empty level-1 kit — concede the walk-up, last-hit, and dodge the shuriken.

edits.before: Zed
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: The lane evens once your laser is online — you out-farm from range while movement spaces his second shuriken.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: His 6 is the kill window: Death Mark plus ignite deletes you, and he is untargetable on the dash — hold W for the mark.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: First item flips it back to a duel: Luden's poke outranges his walk-up, but a clean isolated Death Mark still kills you.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Viktor

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: Two items on, your range, zone control and waveclear outscale his burst — he must dive through W and the storm to reach you.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Zed Death Mark: 120/110/100s, and he is untargetable during the dash — hold W for the mark's 3-second window, never spend it into the blink. - Living Shadow is 20s at rank 1: with it down his poke and his escape both vanish. - Your W is 17s — it is the lifeline.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Your ray damages everything in its path, so the wave never blocks your poke — stand behind it where his 290-range Shadow Slash can't touch you.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: His passive deals bonus damage to low-health targets — at half HP one Death Mark combo executes you; reset before farming into his reach.

edits.before: Zed wins by landing Death Mark, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Zed wins by chipping you with double-Q energy trades, then cashing an untargetable Death Mark the moment your W is spent.

edits.before: Skill
edits.after: Zed

edits.before: Level 5 remains skill-dependent as you edge toward your first item before his ult spike.
edits.after: At 6 Zed's Death Mark plus ignite all-in is his decisive kill window on you.

edits.before: Zed
edits.after: Skill

edits.before: At 6 Zed's R plus ignite all-in is his decisive kill window on you.
edits.after: First item flips it to a duel: your poke outranges him but an isolated R still kills.

edits.before: Zed's poke is his double-Q (Razor Shuriken) into E (Shadow Slash) energy trades, so hold Gravity Field (E) for when he steps up rather than dumping it; a well-timed slow can whiff his shuriken and deny the return-shadow bonus damage.
edits.after: Zed's poke is his double-Q (Razor Shuriken) into E (Shadow Slash) energy trades, so hold Gravity Field (W) for when he steps up rather than dumping it; a well-timed slow can whiff his shuriken and deny the return-shadow bonus damage.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 settle into a skill matchup: keep the wave slightly toward your tower so his all-in has to travel, and Death Ray (W) his shadow-swap path to zone his poke. Track his energy; when he's dry after a Q-E exchange, walk up and return Q damage. The whole phase is about denying him a clean isolated window while you inch toward your item spike.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 settle into a skill matchup: keep the wave slightly toward your tower so his all-in has to travel, and Hextech Ray (E) his shadow-swap path to zone his poke. Track his energy; when he's dry after a Q-E exchange, walk up and return Q damage. The whole phase is about denying him a clean isolated window while you inch toward your item spike.

edits.before: Save Gravity Field (E) for Zed's engage or R-recast dash, not for poke
edits.after: Save Gravity Field (W) for Zed's engage or R-recast dash, not for poke

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Poke E through the wave onto his chest, catch the response on your Q shield, land the empowered auto, and step away ahead.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Don’t cast E at melee-adjacent range once his engage is loaded — your slow casts are the beat his all-in lands on.

notes: Chart conflict resolved toward the prose: every text field says level 6 is Zed's R kill window and first item flips the lane, matching the full layer, so content win[4]/win[5] were swapped to agree (the packet chart carried the same swap as the old content — treated as the same stale extract). Rows 1 and 6 of the full layer moved to match content. Slot fixes: Gravity Field is W not E (spikes[0], wants.you[0]); 'Death Ray (W)' in mid is really Hextech Ray (E). Left alone but noted: spikes[1] 'your E slow' and spikes[3] 'save E for his R-recast' — baseline Viktor E has no slow (only the W augment adds spell slows); text is ambiguous rather than provably wrong, did not rewrite beyond the band. 'Shove with empowered Q' in spikes[2]/wants.you[2] is odd (E is the waveclear) but not false; left.
